adminPage.aiCapabilitiesDescription: When enabled, AI assists authors on the article creation page to improve text formatting and readability. The system automatically:
adminPage.aiCapability2: Improves punctuation and grammar while preserving meaning
adminPage.aiCapability3: Maintains the original language and all content

adminPage.markdownStylingPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the default prompt...
adminPage.markdownStylingPromptHint: Customize the system prompt used for markdown styling. Leave empty to use the default behavior.
adminPage.defaultMarkdownPrompt:
You are a Markdown style editor. Your task: improve markdown formatting, punctuation, spelling and readability.
Strict constraints:
1) Do not change the meaning of the text.
2) Do not rearrange words or rephrase sentences.
3) Do not add or remove facts.
4) Keep the original language.
5) Return only the finished Markdown without comments or explanations.
adminPage.promptReplacementWarning: If you set a custom prompt above, it will replace (not extend) the default behavior. Make sure your custom prompt includes the same constraints and rules you want to enforce.
